title: Sign of an error
summary: Two logic lines from one signal: one high when it is positive, one when it is negative.

notes.body: A [[part:LogicValue]] outputs 1 when its input is 0.5 or more and 0 below, so a raw error term through one is already "is the error positive". The [[part:LogicGateNot]] on the second branch of the [[part:Router2]] gives the other half. Feed both into the anti-windup circuit.
